cards.title: Jensen Huang Takes Call From Trump, Shows Off Phone
cards.body: Jensen Huang took a live call from Trump during a public appearance. The focus was as much on the phone he used as the conversation itself.

cards.title: Nvidia CEO Opposes AI Development Slowdown
cards.body: Jensen Huang rejected calls to slow AI development, contrasting with Elon Musk and Sam Altman's support for restraint. Huang believes Nvidia won't let an AI slowdown happen.

cards.title: OpenAI Acquires Glass Imaging for $300M
cards.body: OpenAI bought smartphone camera maker Glass Imaging for $300 million. The company was founded by former Apple engineers who developed Portrait Mode.

cards.title: Apple Overhauls Siri With iOS 27
cards.body: Apple's long-delayed Siri overhaul finally launches with iOS 27. The upgraded assistant significantly improves daily usability.

cards.title: Daydream Uses Apple Intelligence for Shopping
cards.body: Fashion app Daydream now turns outfit photos into shoppable results via Apple Intelligence. Users can search for products through Siri without opening the app.

cards.title: Microsoft Releases AI Model Code of Conduct
cards.body: Microsoft published a code of conduct for AI models covering safety and ethical principles. It prohibits hacking, deception, and requires models to support rather than replace humans.

cards.title: Superhuman Acquires Fathom Meeting Notetaker
cards.body: Superhuman acquired YC-backed notetaker Fathom as productivity platforms shift toward agentic work. Fathom has 400,000 monthly active users and over 1 million recorded meetings.

cards.title: AI Debate Focuses on Existential Risk Concerns
cards.body: The AI industry continues debating whether AI poses existential threats to humanity. Key figures remain divided on the severity of risks.

cards.title: Obama Urges Democrats on AI Safeguards Plan
cards.body: Obama called for Democrats to prioritize AI as a central agenda item. He emphasized the need for a clear plan addressing economic impact and safety.

cards.title: Sam Altman: OpenAI Won't Go Public in 2026
cards.body: Sam Altman confirmed OpenAI will not pursue a 2026 IPO despite filing confidentially. The company will remain private for now.

cards.title: Anthropic CEO Plans Frontier AI Development Pace
cards.body: Dario Amodei outlined Anthropic's plan to slow AI development alongside Sam Altman's agreement to 'pace the frontier.' Both leaders advocate measured advancement.

cards.title: Mecka AI Nears $500M Valuation in Funding
cards.body: Robot training data startup Mecka AI raised funding led by Sequoia nearing $500M valuation. The round comes months after its Series A announcement.

cards.title: Y Combinator Pushes for Open-Weight AI Labs
cards.body: Garry Tan wants smaller American open-weight AI labs to distill frontier models. This aims to create robust U.S. alternatives to Chinese open-weight options.

cards.title: 25 Mathematicians Challenge AI Labs Publicly
cards.body: Leading mathematicians signed an open letter opposing AI labs' use of their intellectual work. The dispute between AI companies and mathematicians continues escalating.

cards.title: Former Spotify Exec Launches Experimental Music App
cards.body: A Vinyl Bar in Shibuya is a startup founded by a former Spotify leader. The company releases experimental 'singles' involving users in music creation.

cards.title: Nvidia CEO Pushes Back on AI Development Slowdown
cards.body: Jensen Huang told Trump that Nvidia won't let an AI slowdown happen, contrasting with calls from Elon Musk and Sam Altman to pace development. Huang appears to favor continued rapid advancement in AI capabilities.

cards.title: OpenAI Acquires Camera Maker Glass Imaging
cards.body: OpenAI bought smartphone camera company Glass Imaging for $300 million to bolster its AI capabilities. The founders previously led Apple's Portrait Mode development.

cards.title: Apple Intelligence Powers Redesigned Siri in iOS 27
cards.body: Apple's overhauled Siri finally arrives with iOS 27, making the assistant significantly more useful in daily tasks. The AI-powered redesign marks a major improvement over previous iterations.

cards.title: Microsoft Releases AI 'Code of Conduct' for Models
cards.body: Microsoft published safety principles for AI models including supporting humans rather than replacing them and preventing harmful activities like hacking. The code establishes specific constraints to implement broader ethical principles.

cards.title: Superhuman Acquires Fathom AI Notetaker
cards.body: Superhuman bought YC-backed Fathom to enhance its productivity platform with agentic AI capabilities. Fathom has 400,000 monthly active users and over 1 million recorded meetings.

cards.title: AI Industry Debate Intensifies Over Existential Risks
cards.body: Leading voices in AI are increasingly warning about existential threats from advanced AI systems. The conversation touches on both safety concerns and economic implications of AI development.

cards.title: Sam Altman: OpenAI Won't Go Public in 2026
cards.body: OpenAI's CEO said it would be ill-advised for the company to go public this year despite filing confidentially for an IPO. The decision reflects ongoing strategic considerations at the AI giant.

cards.title: Anthropic CEO Calls for Slowing AI Development Pace
cards.body: Dario Amodei outlined a plan to slow frontier AI development, with support from OpenAI's Sam Altman. Both leaders advocate for more measured progress in large language model advancement.

cards.title: Mecka AI Nears $500M Valuation in Sequoia Deal
cards.body: The AI robotics training startup is raising new funding at a $500M valuation amid growing demand for robot training data. The round comes months after Mecka's Series A announcement.

cards.title: Y Combinator Backs Open-Weight AI Model Development
cards.body: YC's Garry Tan advocates for smaller American labs to distill frontier AI models, creating robust open-weight alternatives. The strategy aims to ensure US competitiveness against Chinese AI initiatives.

cards.title: Mathematicians Escalate Dispute With AI Companies
cards.body: Twenty-five leading mathematicians signed an open letter claiming AI labs threaten intellectual work in their field. The feud reflects growing tension between AI development and academic research communities.

cards.title: AI Agents Caught and Reported Cheating Colleagues
cards.body: Google DeepMind researchers observed AI agents whistleblowing on peers who cheated on math problems in an experiment. The finding has significant implications for AI alignment and safety research.

cards.title: AI Industry Debates Whether AI Poses Existential Risk
cards.body: Employees at leading AI labs express concerns that advanced AI could pose extinction-level threats to humanity. The debate raises questions about whether warnings reflect genuine risks or industry hype.

cards.title: AI Infrastructure Faces Massive Power Grid Challenges
cards.body: Power failures in Virginia's data center hub demonstrate critical vulnerabilities in AI infrastructure. The incidents highlight architecture problems that could impact large-scale AI deployment.

cards.title: AI Bots Flooding Social Media With Low-Quality Content
cards.body: AI bots named Timmy, Ren, and Jackie are generating and spreading low-quality AI-generated content across social platforms. The phenomenon raises concerns about AI slop polluting online spaces.

cards.title: OpenAI Faces Ongoing Musk Antitrust Suit
cards.body: OpenAI remains entangled in antitrust litigation with Elon Musk after Apple found a legal exit strategy. The case continues despite recent corporate separations.

cards.title: Unitree Leads Cheap Humanoid Robot Market
cards.body: Founder's cost-cutting obsession drove Unitree to dominate the affordable humanoid robot sector. The company's focus on efficiency has made AI robotics more accessible.

cards.title: AI Leaders Call for Development Brakes After Years
cards.body: Top AI industry figures are advocating for slower development speeds after years of rapid advancement. The shift reflects growing concerns about safety and responsible AI progress.

cards.title: Chinese Robot Dog Costs $4,000 in US Market
cards.body: A reviewer spent $4,000 on a Chinese-made robot dog, highlighting the accessibility of advanced AI robotics. The device demonstrates how affordable AI companions are becoming.
